The '''transpo corsair''' was a model of [[starship]].<ref name="Story Gallery">{{SW|url=andor-s1-e3-story-gallery|text="Reckoning" Story Gallery | Andor|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 1}}</ref> At one point, a [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Kassa" /><ref name="Companion" /> transport corsair, with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems hex icon|emblem]] of the eventual [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]],<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=andor-s1-e3-trivia-gallery|text="Reckoning" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|slide 5}}</ref> crash-landed on the [[planet]] [[Kenari]]. When a local tribe of orphans went to [[Exploratory mission to investigate a downed craft|investigate]]<ref name="Episode 2">{{Andor|That Would Be Me}}</ref> with the hope of finding supplies,<ref name="Companion" /> a surviving member of the crew of the ship [[Death|killed]] their [[Unidentified Alpha leader|leader]], causing the tribe to carry the body back to their [[Kenari Village|village]].<ref name="Episode 2" /> One of their member, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Kassa]], stayed and explored the wreckage of the transport corsair, and was eventually taken offworld by [[Clem Andor|Clem]] and [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]], who were attempting to scavenge the ship but decided to rescue Kassa.<ref name="Episode 3">{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}}</ref>
